lead: Spectroscopy produces numbers that only become results once somebody can interpret them. Most of what is here exists because that step was harder than it needed to be.
paragraphs: I work on the software side of experimental chemistry: X-ray spectra of transition-metal complexes, ligand-field models, and the fitting that connects the two. The measurements are expensive and the interpretation is not automatic.
The tools here close that gap, and more recently the same question has moved to conversational ones — whether a language model can be handed a scientific instrument rather than a description of one.
